title.en: The day the room was born

story.zh: 这是小屋的原图：一张 AI 生成的插画，再用脚本吸附成像素网格。这个网站就是从这里开始的。
story.en: The room's original picture: an AI-generated illustration, snapped to a pixel grid by script. This site started here.
